import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace
from api import resend
from transport import outbox

class ResendTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_preferences(self):
        for enabled in [False, True]:
            with self.subTest(enabled=enabled):
                outbox.clear()
                user = SimpleNamespace(email='a@example.test', preferences=SimpleNamespace(email_enabled=enabled))
                self.assertEqual(resend(user, 'hello'), enabled)
                self.assertEqual(outbox, [('a@example.test', 'hello')] if enabled else [])
